description:
Job Title: SAS Developer 
 Location: Charlotte, NC 
 Contract length: 08+ Months  
 

 Job Description: 
 • Experience in building automated Production environment on SAS Grid 
 • SAS Advanced certified must 
 • Financial institution experience required. – 7+ years, Mortgage industry experience desired. 
 • Teradata and SQL server database experience required – 7+ years 
 • Worked on production report /data delivery (monthly / weekly /daily) – 5+ years 
 • Experience in creating and maintaining process documentation – QA / QC, Runbook, metadata etc. 
 • Independent Leader with strong communication skills (presenting, speaking, writing) who can work with business partners as well as internal team members 
 • Contribute in analyzing root cause/problem/gap analysis and has multi-taking skills and detail oriented.
 


 • SAS and SQL experience – 10+ years 
 • SAS EG experience must – 5 years 
 • SAS UNIX experience must – 5+ years 

 Must be able to pass a background and drug screen
